body:
New notes table (owner_subject = raw JWT sub, sidesteps the local-auth-vs-Google-OAuth subject-shape gap), new NotesHandler (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/notes[/:id]), gated by ordinary RequireAuth only -- ownership itself is the access control. Real, decisive design: ownership checks live in the SQL WHERE clause (id = ? AND owner_subject = ?), a real, honest 404 not a leaked 403. 3 new real tests (ownership isolation, blank-title default, cross-user hijack attempts blocked). go build/vet/test ./... clean, zero regressions. Deliberately not built: real UI, PARENA-backed implementation (plain CRUD needs neither).

⚓ ☃
title: IN-000/IN-001 Phase 1: real IDUNA Notebook (owner-scoped notes CRUD) shipped
